Name: Nyapu Style PolyamorySweet Lantana
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[center] [b][size=5]Lantana- Nyapu Style by AhCuteArt[/size][/b][/center][b][size=5]
[/size][/b]I adore Nyapu's style portraits and custom NPCs. My passion project at the moment is to create Nyapu-style portraits for all the NPCs in my mega-modded SDV file. I've been wanting to create a retexture for Lantana for a while. I am really happy with how she came out. (👀 She's kind of hot, to be honest)


[b]INSTALLATION (Must have Smapi):
[/b]
1. ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url]
2. ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder

[b]There are Two files:[/b]
[Main File] CP is just a drag and drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go.

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. 
You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right.
If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page. 

[i][b]EXTRA: (Winter Outfit Added)
[/b][/i][i]I noticed that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/126026623]ApryllForever[/url] had not programmed Lantana's winter outfit yet, so I added it in. [/i]
[b]

Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/126026623]ApryllForever[/url] for allowing me to retexture their mod.

Downloads.Description: Unzip and drag this into your mods folder, and make sure you have the required files.
This file manually replaces the portraits and is not required if you are using the main CP mod.
